clock: UTC daily synthetic OHLCV bars; not an exchange calendar
volume_basis: Synthetic instrument-volume units; not shares, contracts, ticks, or notional from a named venue
teaching_contract: Six 120-row scenarios × three parameter or seed presets. Component traces, statuses, reasons, classifications, and diagnostics are author-derived.

scenarios.label: Canonical · four regimes
scenarios.description: Four deterministic price regimes with changing participation and three controlled volume shocks.

scenarios.label: Comparison · rise with expanding volume
scenarios.description: A persistent rise with expanding activity separates full-volume signs from return- and range-weighted contributions.

scenarios.label: Comparison · range cycle
scenarios.description: A bounded price cycle with varying activity exposes repeated positive and negative volume contributions.

scenarios.label: Boundary · flat, zero volume, then shock
scenarios.description: A flat zero-range and zero-volume prefix exposes neutral, unchanged, warm-up, and undefined states before a controlled shock.

scenarios.label: Diagnostic · gap versus close location
scenarios.description: Alternating gaps deliberately close near the opposite edge of each bar, separating close-to-close indicators from Chaikin close-location indicators.

scenarios.label: Diagnostic · activity shock without price movement
scenarios.description: Extreme-volume equal-close and zero-range bars expose which formulas contribute zero, dilute a denominator, return neutral, or retain recursive state.
